notes.title: Reborn a Zombie 2 - Progress update
notes.notes:
Greetings, it's been a while! Do not worry, Reborn a Zombie is not dead, quite the contrary!
Reborn a Zombie 1's update status: Cancelled
Wait, there was an update planned?

Indeed! The goal was to implement the French version as well as add controller support. 

You said it was for early 2025

[strike]My personal environment changed rapidly afterward, and I couldn't gather the people necessary to finish the update. The update is stuck at 90% completion. Once it's finished, I'll make sure to let you know, but as it stands, I can't promise any date. Sorry about that :(
[/strike]Update: The game's update cannot be pushed. 
This is time to be transparent.
I am still inexperienced, the update has been dragging for very long  and I made mistakes that ensure the game would be in an actual worse state than what it is today. This is a technical cul-de-sac that I put myself in I hadn't realize at the time

I cannot accept a regression of that level, even if it means renouncing to the major feature planned (french translation, better controller support.)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801201/09d51aac203497133cbb9e3e2015cc3ee4fb5dc6.png"]

To make up for it, here's a new visual of Reborn 2!
Reborn a Zombie 2 update status: Ongoing, and going well!
Now here's the big part!
Reborn a Zombie 2 is progressing nicely.
I've kept quiet this whole time in order to focus on giving everything I've got for this game! Here are the major milestones:

The game's first half is fully playable. You can try it out yourself via our Discord server.

The story of RaZ2 is structured around 2 chapters, each about the length of the first episode. This is the first half.

It still uses placeholder and temporary assets. So be mindful that it's still far from the finished version.

The second half is ongoing and progressing nicely.

I'm halfway done with coding that second half. Reborn a Zombie is written in a way that demands a lot of line-per-line coding and consideration when "directing" the game.

This is why it has taken a lot more time: Reborn a Zombie 2 is a lot more ambitious when it comes to acting and directing. I believe it will pay off in the end, and I hope you're looking forward to it.

The game is completed on its music!

The game is completed on its background art

The game is about 50% done on the character art department. This is where most of the workload is at the moment.

So, do we have a release date?

No! I don't want to announce a release date unless it's 100% certain.

Will it have a french version?

No.

I want to play the game right now AAAAAH

Thank you! I can't wait either. If you want to have weekly updates on the game, please check out my Discord server. That's the best place to see more of what's happening behind the scene!



As always, thank you for being part of this journey. This kind of interaction with you people only make it more joyful.

notes.title: Devlog #3: 2024 Update and the Future of Reborn a Zombie
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44801201/99086fff497ad6f4e56e5adf2af6e00d6cb47dcc.png

A lot has changed in my life in 2024, but I’m happy to say things have been improving. Now, let’s dive into the news:

Reborn a Zombie: Major Update
When?
First half of 2025

What’s new?

 The game will be playable in French.
 Added game controller support.
 A post-credits teaser that will tie into Reborn a Zombie 2.

I personally handled the translation, and while it was a lot of work, it was also a lot of fun. I hope this will allow more people to enjoy the story.

Reborn a Zombie 2 is also expected to receive a French translation.

Reborn a Zombie 2: Entwined Hearts is Progressing, but There’s Still Much to Do
When?
Tentatively 2026

Why the delay?
Depression.
I have a full-time job that demands a lot from me, and this passion project demands even more.

That said, I’m considering running a playtest to gather feedback on the first half of Reborn a Zombie 2. If you’re interested, join our Discord!

The Future of Reborn a Zombie and Asminae Games: Magii Archives
Initially, I planned to announce future games following Reborn a Zombie 2. However, the time required to create each game has made me cautious. What’s the point of announcing games if they might not be delivered?

That said, here’s what I can share:

Reborn a Zombie is part of Magii Archives, a shared universe encompassing all my future games. Think of it as a mix between the Marvel Cinematic Universe and Terry Pratchett’s Discworld in terms of continuity and shared universe.

Each new entry will stand alone but contribute to expanding this universe. Some will progress an overarching narrative, while others will explore fascinating aspects of this world.

Reborn a Zombie is the first series in this universe.

FAQ
Can I play games in any order I want?
Unless a game is a direct sequel, each story is designed to be enjoyable as a standalone. However, playing other games in the Magii Archives will add depth to the experience, as the lore and major events will have repercussion across multiple entries.

Are all Magii Archives games going to be kinetic, slice-of-life visual novels?
Not always. While the focus is on storytelling, I’m open to experimenting with gameplay styles.

Are all Magii Archives games going to be trans-themed?
Reborn a Zombie was born out of my desire to share my experience as a trans person through storytelling. But writing is my passion, and I’m excited to explore a wide range of ideas and experiences in this universe.

What’s Next?
I won’t announce a game until its script is 100% complete. This ensures I can deliver high-quality stories and avoid making false promises.

One such project was Lamia Panic. Although the script was completed in March 2023, its flaws outweighed its strengths. I decided it was best used for worldbuilding instead of a standalone release.

That said, Reborn a Zombie 3 is very likely to happen. No promises yet, but it’s high on my list.

I Want More!
Thank you for your support! The best way to stay updated is through my Discord server. There, you’ll find news on current projects and the Magii Archives universe.

I’m so excited to share these stories with you. I’ve worked in the game industry for five years. Yet, Reborn a Zombie 2 is my most ambitious project, and I’m incredibly proud of it. I hope you’ll enjoy the story as much as I’ve enjoyed creating it.

– Asminae and the Asminae Games Team

notes.title: Reborn a Zombie release:
notes.notes:
After 14 months of hard work, I'm proud to announce that Reborn a Zombie's development is now complete!

The game will release on August, 7th, 2023!

The project has evolved quite a bit from the demo version, so here are the major features:

Support for Steam Deck has been improved!
-The UI has been tweaked to support Steam Deck's 16:10 format. Please note that the build doesn't fully support Steam Deck. So while the game should be playable, expects some issues along the way.
Achievements have been implemented!
-It was a last minute decision to implement achievements throughout the game. Huge thanks to my artist for making the art so quickly!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43903920/a1912f5eac8d1baacb6a9a5d46c902f5b6bd0400.jpg{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43903920/2099277a0e86052ba8e8171c44c5dba59bd30689.jpg
You could say implementing them was a last minute...achievement.
A missing CG has been added
-The demo had a missing CG, while it wasn't necessary to fully understand the scene, it improves it quite a bit. If you played the demo already, I would recommend to take the time to fully enjoy the game

Please note that the demo will be removed upon RaZ release!

What are the plans for the game?
-Adding a log and "Hide textbox" button.
Those aren't currently fully supported for the game.
If you still wish to access them:
Press Space (Keyboad)/Y (Steam Deck) to use the hide feature.
Press L (Keyboard)/R1 (Steam Deck) to reach the Log. Press again to hide it.
-Better Steam Deck support.
There are known issues that will be fixed later down the road, like the credit scene missing music. Please be reminded that full support for Steam Deck isn't planned at the moment.

If you happen to find a typo or a bug, please let me know!

FAQ:
"Why not fixing the issues right away?"
Simply put, working on the project burned me out. I need proper rest!

What's coming next?
I'll say only this: Dawn's journey isn't over!

How can I support you?
First: Thank you! It really means a lot that people expressed their desire to support me, either financially or by recommending RaZ to their friends.
However, for now, there is nothing more you can do than enjoy the game!

DLC? After Stories?
No DLC or After Stories planned. For now.

A few words to conclude
This is my very first game, and one that I hold very dear to my heart. I hope you will find joy in experiencing the story. Thank you for reading me, and have an awesome day!

notes.title: Reborn a zombie - Progress update #2
notes.notes:
Hi there! It's been a while, but I come with good news!
The game's development has been progressing well, and we have an almost-set-in-stone release date.

The game was originally planned to release during pride month, but there's no bad time to be proud! I'm happy to announce that Reborn a zombie will be available starting August 7th for free!

This mean the game is almost ready for everyone to play.
Let's look at what's left to do:
- 1 CG
- All music will be implemented in the following weeks, and I commissioned a sound designer to help out with the sound effects. It's the first time I get to work on SFX so it's an exciting moment!
-  Some polish on the visuals, text and acting.

I plan to add achievements and some level of compatibility with the Steam Deck further down the line. In the demo, the game interface is kinda broken. I can't promise to make the game fully compatible (as I'm still very much a novice when it comes to technical features like this) but I can say for certain: The game will be playable!

That's all for now. I am waiting for you on August, 7th!

Asminae

notes.title: Reborn a zombie - Progress update
notes.notes:
Greetings! Here's an update over the progress made since the release of the demo of Reobnr a zombie!

-Writing: 100%
-Character Art: 100%
-BG Art: 85%
-Programming: 80%
-CG Art: 70%

The game is playable from start to finish. Implementation is going to be the last major step before release. No room for improvisation here, Reborn a Zombie will release!

All the background art is done! The only thing left is to add visual effects!

The character design for all characters is also done, which is the opportunity to give you a quick preview of another character!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43903920/c2579834f70821be68159435e59989bf28c67cdd.png

Who is this mysterious Ronin? Why does she seem to resent Vulcan? Play the game to find out!

Reborn's demo took 8 months to release. However it also taught me many things, including how to manage a healthy workflow for future releases. In comparison to the demo, the full release is going far more smoothly! This is something I'd like to share more insight at a later time, probably in the form of Devlogs.
Thank you for reading, I'll be back soon with more to share!

-Asminae
